summary.answer: The constructor requests persistent seenWZInGameAAR initialization only when its child handle is falsey, and prepares merit reward models with false, then requests WZAAR_Containers and an empty focus target. Visible requires the aarVisible model value to be literal true; the registered model subscription requests reevaluation only when delivered. The registered setState callback, when delivered and its Visible predicate succeeds, requests LockInputHUD(self,true), MenuHidesFreeCursor(menu,delivered controller), then SetupMeritModels(true). MenuHidesFreeCursor does work only when usingfreecursor is truthy: it handles a prior delayed timer, may register close/unhide, and if hidFreeCursor is falsey sets that flag and either clears truthy ignoreNextMenuHides or requests hidden:get()+1.
